evidence.recallIndexableDefinition: same as recall but restricted to merged files with an indexed source extension
evidence.recallUnionDefinition: |(affectedSource ∪ affectedTests) ∩ mergedFiles| / |mergedFiles| — partition-aware recall; the right number to quote when callers do not care about the source/test split
evidence.precisionDefinition: |affectedSource ∩ mergedFiles| / |affectedSource| — expected to be LOW by design (blast radius intentionally includes dependents of changed files)
